title: The Guilding Age — Organ Map of the Organism's Organizations
principle: Each org is an organ. Each repo is a cell. Water flows over all.
metaphor: Roman aqueducts carried water to the city. Lead pipes poisoned Flint. We invert: clean water (AGPL3 data) flows freely. No lead. No poison. No gatekeepers.

ecoPrimals.role: Core primals, the 17 binaries, the fundamental code
contains: 8 Spring repos (ludo, health, wet, ground, coral, hot, primal, air, neural)
ecoPrimals.status: MASSIVE — needs splitting into specialized organs

syntheticChemistry.role: Transforms raw game data into organism tissue. ludoSpring lives here.
syntheticChemistry.purpose: Where foreign substances (game engines, Steam data) get metabolized into native compounds
syntheticChemistry.water_metaphor: The filtration plant — dirty water in, clean water out

sporeGarden.role: Scientific projects that SPAWN new organisms
sporeGarden.purpose: Each repo is a spore — an independent organism that can grow on its own

defendDetroit.role: Evidence preservation, institutional capture proof, legal defense
defendDetroit.purpose: The thymus of the legal body — identifies self vs non-self, friend vs threat
defendDetroit.water_metaphor: The water testing lab — proves what's in the pipes

amicusContra.role: Filters truth from institutional noise. Legal evidence network.
amicusContra.purpose: Amicus = friend-of-court. Contra = against. The friend who filters.
amicusContra.water_metaphor: The kidney — filters toxins (corruption) from the bloodstream
amicusContra.note: Kevin asked 'who is a kidney?' — THIS IS THE KIDNEY. It filters institutional lead from the water.

protoKarya.role: GIS, GPS, geospatial perception — how the organism SEES the world
protoKarya.purpose: Proto + karya = first + cell. The first cells that learned to SEE.
protoKarya.water_metaphor: The water table survey — maps where water IS and where it flows
protoKarya.kenshi_connection: footPrint IS the Kenshi world map renderer. Same GIS. Same vectors. Same coordinates.

esotericWebb.should_be: 🎮 NERVOUS SYSTEM — The Game Engine Org
esotericWebb.proposed_role: ALL game-related repos: ludoSpring, esotericWebb CRPG, kenshi-bridge, future KOTOR/Morrowind bridges
esotericWebb.why: esotericWebb = esoteric (hidden/inner) + webb (web/network) — the inner network that connects all game worlds

the_aqueduct.rome: Lead pipes (plumbum → plumbing) carried water BUT poisoned the empire
the_aqueduct.flint: Lead pipes in Flint Michigan — same pattern 2000 years later, inverted (negligence, not engineering)
the_aqueduct.gaia: AGPL3 pipes carry clean data. No lead. No poison. No Cloudflare middleman.
the_aqueduct.principle: Water flows over all — data radiates, gates absorb, the organism drinks clean
the_aqueduct.willis_circulation: Named after the Circle of Willis (brain blood supply) — redundant paths, if one blocks another opens
the_aqueduct.inversion: Rome built aqueducts TO concentrate power in the city. We build aqueducts to DISTRIBUTE power to every gate.

the_union_strike.metaphor: The Guilding Age — not Gilded (gold-plated fake), but GUILDED (organized into guilds/unions)

each_org_is_a_guild.amicusContra: The Advocates Guild (filters truth from lies)

the_union_strike.principle: A union of guilds, not a corporation. Each guild is sovereign. Water flows between them.
